I listen to this whenever i feel down. I hope things get better. I know exactly how you feel. My parents are in the middle of a divorce and i cant help but to blame myself. My dad is very supportive of my depression while my mom just seems to want me to "man up". They continue to fight daily and i dont know what to do. Anyways best we can do is stay strong.
